name: Duesenberg
source:
"Ara, how are you. Do you want to talk a little?"

[url=/c29971]Hiro's[/url] Substance partner.
He's a male, but his actions and way of speaking are very feminine.
He has a weakness for beautiful things and is always devoted to caring for his own beauty.
He has a kind personality and is always looking out for those around him.
